description: This file declares functions and includes headers related to PDU session management, DRB setup/modification, and RRC reconfiguration in a 5G network protocol stack, specifically for the OCUDU project.

methods.name: verify_and_log_cell_group_config
methods.description: Verifies and logs the cell group configuration based on the provided byte buffer.

methods.name: fill_f1ap_drb_setup_mod_item
methods.description: Fills the DRB setup modification item for the DU based on various input parameters.

methods.name: fill_e1ap_drb_pdcp_config
methods.description: Fills E1AP PDCP configuration from CU-CP PDCP configuration.

methods.name: fill_e1ap_qos_flow_param_item
methods.description: Fills E1AP QoS flow parameter item based on request item.

methods.name: fill_e1ap_bearer_context_list
methods.description: Fills E1AP bearer context list from DRB setup/mod items and session update list.

methods.name: fill_e1ap_pdu_session_res_to_setup_list
methods.description: Fills list of PDU sessions to be set up in E1AP message.

methods.name: fill_drb_to_setup_list
methods.description: Fills list of DRBs to be set up.

methods.name: fill_drb_to_modify_list
methods.description: Fills list of DRBs to be modified.

methods.name: fill_drb_to_remove_list
methods.description: Fills list of DRBs to be removed.

methods.name: fill_rrc_reconfig_args
methods.description: Fills RRC reconfiguration message content with provided parameters.

methods.name: update_setup_list_with_ue_ctxt_setup_response
methods.description: Processes UE context setup response and updates bearer and DRB setup lists.
